source_authority: Japan Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) / Japan Aeronautical Engineers' Association
source_title: 航空分野（空港グランドハンドリング）特定技能評価試験実施要領

language.foreign_language_annotations: May be added for technical terms
language.app_policy: Japanese-first exam simulation; English and Sinhala explanations belong to learning/review mode, not as a replacement for the Japanese exam interface.

grade_1.pass_rule: At least 65% correct separately in both academic and practical sections.

grade_2.pass_rule: At least 65% correct separately in both academic and practical sections.

academic: Aircraft safety: aircraft priority, danger zones, dangerous goods transport, weight and balance, aviation security
Work safety: compliance with rules, weather, worker clothing/PPE, vehicle operation
Air transport quality: safety and quality of work, basic work concepts
Prevention: near-miss reports, pointing-and-calling, hazard prediction
practical: Collect and understand information from work instructions
Understand cargo/load information and prepare accordingly

academic: Advanced knowledge across the Grade 1 subject domains

official_exam_delivery: Paper-based test; academic and practical tests are conducted on paper. Practical assessment uses judgement and planning/work-planning tasks.
public_materials: MLIT guideline states that the exam body publishes the implementation guideline, study text, and sample questions free of charge on its dedicated website.
app_implementation_rules: Do not label the existing 14 practice papers as official exams.
Do not assume the current 654 question references match the 2026 specification until question-level audit is completed.
Build Grade 1 simulator to 30 academic questions/45 minutes and 15 practical questions/30 minutes only for practice alignment.
Keep Grade 2 as a separate syllabus and assessment profile.
Keep exact Japanese question wording in Japanese Exam mode; display furigana when available.
Show English and Sinhala explanations after answering or in Learning mode.
Use the official 65% pass threshold separately for academic and practical results.
Do not represent the app's web CBT interface as the official paper examination.

references.title: JAEA Airport Ground Handling support and sample questions
